text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Darn it... I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I worked hard, but I could've
pushed more!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ha... it's funny.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I would just be sulking, saying
"I knew
it" or something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But not now. I know I can use this experience to do better in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I... must've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Impressive work, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I learned a lot from competing with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seeing you give it your all was
something
else, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's run together again!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those two really know how to take
things in
stride. They're already thinking
about the future.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You can tell they don't dwell on their
failures.
Instead, they're already racing
towards their next
victory.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio was the same way. That's why she's
so strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I always limited myself,
believing I
couldn't do more, no matter
how hard I tried.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I thought the same thing about third
place. I had
given up, thinking that I
couldn't go any further...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But that was wrong. If I want to shine
bright, I
need to change my mindset.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I need to aim for first. That way,
even if I
finish in
third... I'm still moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Doubt no longer clouds Nice Nature's
vision. Even in a larger race, she'll
continue to challenge
herself and others,
undaunted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only one race can give her even more
confidence
and prestige...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho!
choice_data_list: Why don't we run the Tenno Sho (Au...
How about running the Tenno Sho (A...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Me? In the Tenno Sho? With its long
history and
heritage?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...No, what am I getting shaky again for?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't worry whether or not I deserve to
be in the
race. I have to believe that I'm
worthy and cheer
myself on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's take that grand autumn stage by
storm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide that she will compete
in the autumn Tenno Sho, the race that
determines the
best medium-distance
runner!
